REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_AFTERLIFE.descript:
At the start of your turn, [gold]Osty[/gold] heals {Heal:diff()} HP.
If [gold]Osty[/gold] is dead, [gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_BOLAS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
At the start of your next turn, return this to your [gold]Hand[/gold], and increase its attack damage by {IncrementAmount:diff()}.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_CONSUMING_SHADOW.d: Record the damage of the last [gold]Dark[/gold] you [gold]Evoked[/gold]. Newly channeled [gold]Dark[/gold] Orbs inherit half of its damage.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_CORPSE_EXPLOSION.d:
Apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold]. 
When the enemy dies, deal damage equal to its Max HP to ALL enemies.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_FOREGONE_CONCLUSIO: Before your turn starts, put {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_FORGOTTEN_RITUAL.d:
If you [gold]Exhausted[/gold] a card this turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Increase this card's cost by 1.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_GLASSWORK.descript:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Glass[/gold].
Increase the damage of your [gold]Glass[/gold] Orbs by {IfUpgraded:show:3|2}.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_GRAVE_WARDEN.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Soul+|Soul}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_HAND_TRICK.descrip:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Add [gold]Sly[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] this combat.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_HEIRLOOM_HAMMER.de:
[gold]Forge[/gold] {Forge:diff()}.
Choose a Colorless card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Add {IfUpgraded:show:an upgraded|a} copy of that card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_INFINITE_BLADES.de:
At the start of your turn, add 1 [gold]Shiv[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
{Cards:diff()} [gold]{Cards:plural:Shiv|Shivs}[/gold] do not count toward your [gold]Hand Size[/gold].
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_LIMIT_BREAK.title: Limit Break
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_MASTER_PLANNER.des: Whenever you discard a [gold]Sly[/gold] card, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_NEUTRON_AEGIS.desc:
Gain X [gold]Plating[/gold].
Double X if it's {Stars:diff()} or more.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_REAPER_FORM.descri:
Whenever Attacks deal damage, apply that much [gold]Doom[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
At the start of your turn, kill enemies with at least as much [gold]Doom[/gold] as HP.|}
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_RIGHT_HAND_HAND.de:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you play a card costing {Required:energyIcons()} or more, put this into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and reduce its cost by {Energy:energyIcons()}.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_SEANCE.description: Transform a card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Soul+|Soul}[/gold].
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_SIC_EM.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] hits this enemy, [gold]Summon[/gold] {SicEmPlusPower:diff()}.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_SHATTER.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Evoke[/gold] all of your Orbs {IfUpgraded:show:twice|once}.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_SPINNER.descriptio: At the start of your turn, [gold]Channel[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} [gold]Glass[/gold], and trigger the passive ability of all [gold]Glass[/gold] Orbs.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_SPUR.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] heals {Heal:diff()} HP.
For every [blue]2[/blue] excess HP healed, [gold]Summon 1[/gold] more.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_SYNCHRONIZE.descri:
Record newly [gold]Channeled[/gold] orb.
The first time you record a new type of Orb, gain {SynchronizePlusPower:diff()} [gold]Focus[/gold].
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_ROCKET_PUNCH.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Whenever you create a Status, reduce this card's cost to 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} until played.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_TANK.description: At the end of your turn, other players gain {TankPlusPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_WISP.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. 
Transform a random [gold]Soul[/gold] in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into a copy of this card.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_WELL_LAID_PLANS.de: At the end of your turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] up to {RetainAmount:diff()} {RetainAmount:plural:card|cards}.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_WITHER.description:
Decrease this card's damage by {PerLevel}.
At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], take {Damage:diff()} damage.
REBALANCED_SPIRE_CARD_WITHER.extraDescri:
Take an extra turn after your turn.
Increase this card's cost by 1.
At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], take {Fixed} damage.
